text.p: Following are some of the main stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Livestock feed producer Nutreco considers Amsterdam bourse listing this summer. (p1,3)
- Rotterdam province to take control of port. (p1)
- Junior Affairs Minister Frank de Grave will not stop unemployment benefit funds returning excess premiums to workers and employers. (p1)
- Spain's state-owned airline Iberia eyes taking five pct stake in KLM. (p3)
- French building supplies company Bricorama takes over continental European branches of Britain's Wickes.
- Dutch brewer Heineken asks customers to return promotional air beds found to be bad for environment. (p2)
- Union boss Johan Stekelenburg to join ING Groep NV supervisory board from September 1. (p7)
- KLM no longer first choice as partner for Spanish airline Iberia. (p7). -
